label: BUY SMART
title: Your Olive Young shopping list for Seoul
dek: How to shop Korea's biggest beauty store like a local.

points.t: Olive Young runs big sales several times a year and a member sale every month. Check before your trip.
Products with Olive Young Awards labels are best-sellers chosen from Korean sales and reviews.
Many products and sets are sold only in Korea; they make the best souvenirs and gifts.
Tourists can often get tax back at the counter above a minimum spend. Bring your passport.
